stage: S1-D5 fixed privileged audit of original RGB matching costs
input_candidates: all frozen original D1 positive UV/depths, unchanged; then evaluator-only grouping by GT visible static surface
source_indices: original frozen six source indices, first4 fit/best3 mean and last2 held
matcher: unchanged adaptive_static.geometry patch_features(kernel5) and source_cost, FP32, no trained weights or modified costs
hypotheses: nearest original192-level inverse-depth grid hypothesis to static GT
nearest_grid: round((1/GT-1/near)/((1/far-1/near)/191)) clamped integer0..191, inherited camera-derived near/far
oracle_acceptance: unchanged D4 equation: finite positive, fit<=old+1e-6, both held<=old+1e-6, at least one held<old-1e-6; purely evaluator statistic
reference_single_face_group: all25 reference5x5 pixels static-visible with positive static GT and world-normal dot center>0.99; border/missing/mixed is separate
source_true_visibility: analytic intersections from source camera origin toward reference GT world point, expected hit parameter1; closest observed hit abs(t-1)<=1e-4 and original project_torch geometry margin valid
source_groups: at least3 of4 fit and both held visible
report: denominators, original/GT/grid cost distributions and differences, unit-cost frequency, continuous/grid oracle acceptance rates, cross-groups, all aggregate and per-view; source checks are not independent GT

analytic_controls.A_fractional: plane world_z=4, source w2c x translations[0,.2,.4,.6,-.2,-.4,-.6]
analytic_controls.C_slanted: plane .4*world_x+world_z=4, translations asA; direct analytic ray-plane RGB
analytic_controls.outputs: fixed curve/minimum/GT-cost diagnostics, no optimization or candidate chosen for training

allowed_outputs: aggregated/per-view JSON and logs, declared analytic control curves, fixed0/24/72 RGB/color figures only
